activeSources.polling: Conservative 10-second polling with ETag/Last-Modified when available
activeSources.retention: Internal decision fields and hashes only; no body redistribution endpoint
activeSources.failureSemantics: 403/429/5xx/login wall/schema drift/time parse/empty list are visible source errors; no hidden fallback

activeSources.takerSideMapping: aggTrade.m=true => taker SELL; false => taker BUY
activeSources.gapSemantics: Duplicate and out-of-order messages are discarded; unresolved ID/time gaps are explicit and dependent conditions become UNKNOWN
activeSources.retention: Rolling runtime window plus append-only Shadow evidence
activeSources.failureSemantics: Disconnect/stale/symbol gap affects only dependent conditions; no second exchange or stale-data fallback

upgradeRule: Any additional source requires a separate product decision and measured incremental information value; none is an implicit fallback.
